part.text:
All tests pass. 

I implemented `Recite(startBottles, takeDown int) []string` in `bottle_song.go`:

- A `numberWords` map (0–10) supplies the count words, with `0` mapped to `"no"`.
- `bottlePhrase(count)` builds the `"<number> green bottle(s)"` fragment, switching to the singular `"bottle"` when the count is 1.
- `Recite` emits one 4-line verse per iteration, capitalizing the count word at the start of the first two lines, and inserts a blank line between verses (not after the last one).

I used a small `capitalize` helper instead of the deprecated `strings.Title` (the test file ships its own copy, but non-test code can't reference symbols defined in `_test.go` files). `go test ./...` reports `ok bottlesong`.
